notes: Vehicle scan: Settings > Vehicle > Scan vehicle finds the CAN data your deck already receives (AC, fan, lights, doors) and saves a report file to Downloads you can send back - two guided steps, identifiers stripped out. Overlay panels are now locked by default: no move/resize grips or frame eating the corners, so a panel is all content (turn grips back on in Settings > Overlay > Panel layout while rearranging).
